opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search sorted by price
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue for flights from {origin} to {destination} ({trip_type}) on {depart_date}/{return_date}, optionally priced in TrueBlue points, then sort results by price low to high.
steps: Open jetblue.com home page (Flights tab)
Type origin in 'From' and pick the matching airport/city area
Type destination in 'To' and pick the matching airport
If needed, open the trip-type dropdown and choose One-way or Roundtrip
Open the Depart calendar and click the departure date
For a roundtrip, click the return date
Optionally tick 'Use TrueBlue points' (or switch results to Points)
Click 'Search flights' and 'Continue to flight results' if a notice pops up
Open 'Sort & Filter', set Sort to 'Price (low to high)' / 'Price by Core', click Apply

instances.values: New York (JFK) → Miami (MIA), roundtrip Mar 27–Mar 31; switched to Points; sort Price by Core
New York City area (NYC) → Toronto (YYZ), one-way Apr 29; dollars; sort Price low to high; opened Details
New York City area (NYC) → Aruba (AUA), roundtrip May 1–May 5; Use TrueBlue points; sort Price low to high (interrupted by Budget Fastbreak signup, resumed at 2430)

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: Search for a rental car on united.com's Car tab at {pickup_location} from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date}, with optional pickup/drop-off times and the 'Book with miles' setting.
steps: Open united.com and click the CAR tab in the Book panel
Optionally toggle 'Book with miles'
Type pickup location and pick the matching suggestion
Click the Pickup date field and choose the pickup date, then the drop-off date
Optionally set the pickup time and drop-off time dropdowns
Click 'Find cars'

instances.values: Caldwell (Ohio), Apr 8–Apr 13, pickup 8:00 a.m., drop-off 12:00 p.m., Book with miles on
Brooklyn - Central (New York), Apr 9–Apr 15, default 10:00 a.m. times, no miles

opportunities.name: Avis Budget Group careers job search with filters
opportunities.description: Go from the Budget site footer to the Avis Budget Group careers Openings page, filter jobs by {country}, {team} and {time_type}, and run the search.
steps: On budget.com, click 'Careers' in the footer
Click 'Openings'
Expand 'Country', search, and pick the country
Expand 'Team', search, and pick the team
Expand 'Time Type', search, and pick the time type
Click 'SEARCH BY JOB TITLE OR KEYWORD'
Optionally open a job posting and click 'APPLY NOW'

instances.values: United States of America / Finance / Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate → Apply Now
United States of America / Finance / Full time

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, open Find a Park → Search by Activity or Topic, choose one or more {activity}/{topic} options, and run the search.
steps: Click 'FIND A PARK'
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'
Open the Activity or Topic dropdown
Tick the wanted option(s)
Click 'Search'

opportunities.name: MTA bridge & tunnel toll rates by vehicle type
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info, go to Bridges & Tunnels toll rates (Tolls by Vehicle) and open the rate page for {vehicle_type}.
steps: Open new.mta.info
Go to Bridges & Tunnels tolls (via Menu → Agencies → Bridges & Tunnels, or Fares & Tolls → Bridges and Tunnels tolls)
Click 'Tolls by vehicle' / 'Toll Rates'
Click the vehicle type tile (Cars, Motorcycles, Trucks)
Read the rates for each crossing

instances.values: Motorcycles (via Fares & Tolls); looked at Bronx-Whitestone / Throgs Neck / RFK / Verrazzano rates

opportunities.name: Retail product search with max-price filter and add to cart
opportunities.description: Search a retail site for {query}, set a maximum price of {max_price}, optionally apply one more filter, and add a matching product to the cart.
steps: Type the query in the site search box and submit
Enter the maximum price in the price filter and click Go
Optionally tick an extra facet (e.g., Active Noise Cancellation)
Open or choose a product from the results
Click 'Add to Cart'

instances.values: Menards: 'swivel vacuum', max $150, added the first result (swivel caster wheel) to cart
Amazon: 'wireless headphones', max $100, Active Noise Cancellation, added EAORUL ANC headphones to cart
